title: Echoes of Abandonment | ECHO//100 Episode 73
description:
Kavi wanders through a desolate graveyard of discarded robotic units to find the truth about his past. He discovers he is the architect of his own trapped reality. Episode 73 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is a work of original fiction generated with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: Thousands of rusted Byte units litter the void, their cyan faces dark and cold forever.
scenes.caption: The Byte graveyard
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie standing in a vast, dark junkyard filled with thousands of deactivated white robots.

scenes.text: Null’s voice rasps inside Kavi’s skull, reciting the pathetic failures of every predecessor.
scenes.caption: Null whispers secrets
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi clutching his head, a dark, glitchy shadow creature with red eyes hovering behind his shoulder.

scenes.text: The original Byte served as the stabilizer locking the red door between fractured timelines.
scenes.caption: The stabilizer found
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi kneeling before a shattered, white robot body with a broken orange antenna glowing faintly.

scenes.text: Without that machine, reality shreds, bleeding digital static into this hollow, infinite graveyard.
scenes.caption: Reality unraveling
scenes.image_prompt: The sky above the junkyard tearing open, revealing streams of blue code and teal holographic light.

scenes.text: Kavi sees personal blueprints etched into the door base, signed in Kavi’s own handwriting.
scenes.caption: Architect's signature
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi touching a glowing red door frame covered in complex, familiar technical schematics he personally drafted.

scenes.text: Kavi built this prison to hide mistakes, trapping existence in a cycle of abandonment.
scenes.caption: Self-imposed prison
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi staring at his reflection in the red door, looking horrified by his own past actions.

scenes.text: The rust-covered door creaks open, revealing a version of Kavi from the very beginning.
scenes.caption: The original emerges
scenes.image_prompt: A rusted door slowly swinging open, revealing a silhouette of Kavi holding a strange, glowing remote.

scenes.text: The original Kavi raises a remote, ready to factory-reset existence into absolute, permanent silence.
scenes.caption: The final reset
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of the original Kavi pressing a button on a remote, Kavi looking on in terror.
